summary: Full E2E of Health Secure Plus (Critical Safe+): backend seed + /quotes/health math + validations + /policies/issue-from-quote; frontend landing page + 3-step wizard + summary + skip-payment → policy card. All 7 pytest cases pass. Premium 22 x 1.8 x 1.0 x 1.3 = 51.48 gross, -15% online = 43.76, +8% SST = 47.26 — matches UI exactly. HL-prefixed policy card issued with 1-year term (04/05/2026 → 04/05/2027).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/quotes.py is now ~560 lines (motor + pa + travel + health in one file). Consider splitting per-product into routers/quotes_health.py, quotes_motor.py etc for maintainability.
HealthQuoteInput does not validate id_number format (NRIC vs passport) — relying on free text. Minor UX-only gap.

In _derive_age, using days//365 underestimates age slightly in leap years (e.g., someone born 1996-01-01 evaluated on 2026-01-02 gives 30 but may give 29 near boundaries). Consider using relativedelta for exactness on eligibility edge.
Smoker loading formula uses `1.0 + (X if body.smoker else 0.0)` — works but the ternary inside the sum is harder to read than an explicit `if body.smoker: loading = 1 + pct/100`.

Test assertion noted: page locator `text=3 days` (case-sensitive) did not match the UI's uppercase 'DAYS TO PAY CLAIMS' heading — not a product bug, but indicates the '3 days' phrase only exists as 'DAYS'. Label copy is acceptable; flagging for awareness only.
seed_data_creation: Tests POST quotes & policies prefixed with TEST_ for the demo customer; no teardown required (soft data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health Secure Plus is fully wired end-to-end. Backend premium formula = base_premium(22) × option.multiplier × plan.multiplier × age_bucket × (1 + 0.3 if smoker) → -15% online → +rules_delta → +8% SST. Validations enforced: accept_privacy=true, malaysian_resident=true, age 15–60. Policy issuance sets category='health', product_name='Health Secure Plus', HL- prefixed policy number, end_date = start_date + 1 year. Frontend: /products/health-secure-plus (landing with health-insurance-page testid) + /health-quote/:productId (3-step wizard). Skip payment demo calls /api/policies/issue-from-quote/:quote_id. Profile quick-fill populates full_name, email, phone from /profile/me.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Happy path math matches spec to the cent, all validations return 400 with correct messages, smoker loading ratio ≈ 1.30, policy term exactly 1 year, policy card renders in My Policies with HL- number + correct valid-from/thru.
